sovereign_country.strategic_role: 12.5%统一企业税、CySEC外汇券商牌照与游戏发行业务

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Retail of Home Hydroponics and Gardening Equipment

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Cyprus (unitary national jurisdiction; uniform corporate and tax law, no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (Companies Law Cap. 113 derived from English Companies Act 1948) with an extensive EU-derived statutory overlay in AML/CFT, data protection, e-commerce, and corporate transparency
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: EU Single Market - TFEU freedom of establishment and cross-border e-commerce rules
Cyprus-Hong Kong SAR Double Taxation Agreement
Cyprus-People's Republic of China Double Taxation Agreement (superseding the 1990 treaty)
OECD Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters (MAAC)
Hague Convention of 5 October 1961 on Apostilles (in force for Cyprus)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Companies Law, Cap. 113 (ss.22 and 101; Part 12A on the Register of Beneficial Owners); Companies (Amendment) Law 2021 (L.31(I)/2021) establishing the mandatory UBO filing with DRCOR; The Prevention and Suppression of Money Laundering Activities Law 188(I)/2007, as amended (incl. L.13(I)/2021 transposing the EU 5th AML Directive); Cyprus implementing regulations for EU and UN financial sanctions and Ministry of Foreign Affairs sanctions lists. Access to the Cyprus Beneficial Owners Register is restricted to competent authorities and AML-regulated obliged entities in line with CJEU judgments C-37/20 and C-601/20; no public access.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized true copy of the passport pages of each appointed director, shareholder, and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority of the country of origin with notarization by a local notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the competent apostille authority of the country of origin; consular legalization required for non-Apostille states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Memorandum and Articles of Association of the corporate shareholder (if any)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization for non-Apostille states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Incumbency of the corporate shareholder (if any)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry or licensed registered agent of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization for non-Apostille states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement issued within 3 months) for each director and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or local bank of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille; certified English/Greek translation where the source document is not in English

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and banker's status letter for each UBO and/or corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Relationship bank in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank-sealed original on bank letterhead; apostille required only if demanded by the receiving Cypriot bank or the AML-regulated service provider

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source of wealth / source of funds declaration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Each UBO and director, signed before a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille (or consular legalization); certified translation into English/Greek

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional curriculum vitae and business background statement of the appointed directors and UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified by a licensed Cyprus advocate or fiduciary firm; apostille not ordinarily required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory automated screening of all directors, shareholders, and UBOs against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, Cyprus national sanctions list (Ministry of Foreign Affairs), and OFAC SDN List (required because Stripe and PayPal operate USD/US rails); prudent cross-check against the UK HMT sanctions list. PEP determination under Art. 2(2) and CDD duties under Art. 26 of Law 188(I)/2007; PEPs, including domestic PEPs, must receive enhanced due diligence. Screening runs at onboarding, at each material change, and periodically (at least every 48 hours via compliant automated tools). Any positive match triggers immediate escalation to the compliance officer and, if required, a suspicious transaction report to MOKAS; negative media and adverse-information checks are mandatory.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (DRCOR) of the Republic of Cyprus - official e-services portal of the Ministry of Energy, Commerce and Industry
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names are accepted in Greek or Latin characters; where a name is in Greek, an English transliteration must be submitted. The statutory suffix 'Limited' or 'Ltd' must appear at the end of the English name. The proposed name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered name, must not convey regulated activity without the relevant license, and must not be contrary to public policy. For a cross-border e-commerce trading company, the English Latin-script name will be the operating name used with Stripe and PayPal.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Credit Institution - Central Bank of Cyprus authorization required
Insurance, Reinsurance, Insurance Intermediary - Superintendent of Insurance authorization required
Investment Firm, CIF, Investment Services, Asset Management - CySEC authorization required
Fund, UCITS, AIF, Fund Manager - CySEC licensing and registration applicable
Trust, Trustee, Trust Services - Central Bank of Cyprus fiduciary licensing required
Gaming, Betting, Casino - Cyprus Gaming and Casino Supervision Commission license required
University, College, School - Ministry of Education and Culture approval required
Charity, Foundation, Philanthropic - registration under the Cyprus Charities Law and relevant ministry approval
Republic, Government, National, Municipal, Official - reserved for state entities; prior ministerial approval required
Cyprus, Cypriot - permitted only with documented local nexus and administrative review by DRCOR
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name refusal is notified in writing by DRCOR with the statutory ground (identical or confusingly similar to an existing name, or undesirable under s.22(2) Cap.113). The applicant may (i) file a written objection with the Registrar within 14 days of the refusal, or (ii) submit a fresh application with a materially distinctive name variant and an additional fee. If the Registrar upholds the refusal, the applicant may file a recourse for annulment with the Cyprus Administrative Court under Art.146 of the Constitution within 75 days of the final decision; representation by a Cyprus-licensed advocate is mandatory. Name reservations are valid for 180 days without statutory extension; before expiry, a fresh reservation application with the prescribed fee may be submitted to preserve priority.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual mailbox does not satisfy the statutory registered office requirement under s.101 Cap.113; the registered office must be a physical Cyprus address where legal process and official notices can be served during business hours. A service-provider virtual office may support remote administration, but the company must maintain commercial substance documentation (board minutes, management decisions, accounting records, and e-commerce operational records) sufficient to preserve the 12.5% corporate tax rate, treaty benefits, and the low-risk AML classification for the online hydroponics retail model.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low - approximately 5% annual probability of an unannounced on-site inspection. Cyprus authorities (Inland Revenue, Social Insurance Services, and MOKAS) usually conduct announced, document-based audits; unannounced visits are rare for a license-exempt, low-risk e-commerce entity and are typically triggered by tax selection algorithms or AML referrals rather than routine compliance patrolling.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (DRCOR), Ministry of Energy, Commerce and Industry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee under the Companies Law (Cap.113) fee regulations; current DRCOR tariff for name reservation application (approx. EUR 50)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company incorporation and registration fee (private limited company with share capital)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (DRCOR)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration scale under the Companies Law (Cap.113); approximate EUR 150 for a standard authorized capital structure

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Government Printing Office of Cyprus (Official Gazette)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille bundle (up to 6 corporate and personal due diligence documents, including certified translations)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of approximately EUR 40 per document plus the applicable Hague Apostille statutory fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office address in Cyprus (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cyprus-licensed corporate service provider or law firm

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and corporate secretary services (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cyprus-licensed fiduciary or corporate services firm

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register initial compilation, verification, and electronic filing with DRCOR
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cyprus law firm or licensed corporate service provider (DRCOR imposes no separate state filing fee)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market professional fee for Stage 1 due diligence, sanctions screening setup, and AML/CFT onboarding review

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law, Cap. 113 of the Republic of Cyprus, as amended (principally ss. 3, 6, 7, 8, 29 and Table A); supplemented by Companies Law (Amendment) No. 98(I)/2015 regarding the General Register of Companies and Beneficial Owners.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (RoC), Ministry of Energy, Commerce and Industry, Republic of Cyprus.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of a private limited company and Form HE1 incorporation application, filed with the RoC.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a private limited company under Cap. 113, s. 8; recommended 1,000 ordinary shares of EUR 1.00 each fully paid to evidence substance. No escrow account or capital verification deposit applies to general e-commerce retailing; payment rails operate purely on standard bank KYC.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: (1) The subscribers to the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Company do hereby take and subscribe to 1,000 ordinary shares of one Euro (EUR 1.00) each, numbered 1-1,000, fully paid; (2) The Company's registered office be adopted at [address], Nicosia, Cyprus; (3) [Director Name] be appointed sole Director and [Secretary Name] be appointed Secretary of the Company, each to hold office until vacated by law; (4) The Director be authorised to open and settle bank and payment accounts, engage the external auditor and company secretary service, and execute all statutory filings; (5) This resolution be effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Availability Search and Reservation (Name Clearance)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (RoC), Ministry of Energy, Commerce and Industry, Republic of Cyprus
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a pre-incorporation name search through the RoC's online e-registry or paper filing. Submit Form K01 for name clearance specifying the suffix 'Limited' or 'Ltd'. The proposed name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered Cypriot company or to a protected trademark. Keep the reservation within the validity window pending filing of the incorporation application.
required_dossiers: Completed name clearance application (Form K01)
Photocopy of passport or national ID of each proposed subscriber
Utility bill or proof of residential address of each proposed shareholder and director
Instructing letter from the corporate tax compliance pipeline
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity, either submit a revised proposed name or obtain a signed letter of consent from the conflicting entity; a formal refusal may be challenged by written representations to the RoC or by recourse under Article 146 of the Cyprus Constitution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution and Legalization of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Cyprus notary public or practising advocate; apostille of legalised signatures issued by the Cyprus Ministry of Foreign Affairs for foreign banking use
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association (M&A) in conformity with Cap. 113 and Table A. The objects clause shall expressly include 'online retail distribution of home hydroponics, garden technology and related equipment' (ISIC 4791). Record the share capital structure of 1,000 ordinary shares of EUR 1.00 each. Each subscriber signs before a witness; for remote execution, use electronic signature or mail execution and arrange notarial legalisation and apostille to support subsequent bank and processor KYC.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association (duly stamped)
Articles of Association (duly stamped)
Passport copies of subscribing shareholders
Statement of compliance for signing (Form HE2)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RoC rejects the M&A on formal grounds, including incorrect stamping or defective objects clause, correct the document and resubmit; written submissions may be lodged within 14 days of the requisition notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application with the Registrar of Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver, Nicosia, Republic of Cyprus
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the signed M&A, Form HE1, statutory declarations (Forms HE2/HE3) and written consents of the first director and secretary at the RoC. Pay the official filing fee of approximately EUR 190 (USD 205). The Registrar examines the legality of the constitution, reverifies the cleared name and issues the Certificate of Incorporation under s. 7 Cap. 113. The incorporation is subsequently published in the Official Gazette of the Republic.
required_dossiers: Form HE1 application for incorporation
Memorandum and Articles of Association (stamped)
Statutory declarations of compliance (Form HE2 and HE3)
Written consent of each director and secretary to act
Consent of the registered office holder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, respond by corrected resubmission or written representations within 14 days; an adverse registration decision may be remedied by refiling the defective form and, if necessary, by judicial review pursuant to Article 146 of the Cyprus Constitution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Publication in the Official Gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver; Government Printing Office of the Republic of Cyprus
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the RoC issues the Certificate of Incorporation with the company registration number bearing the 'HE' prefix. Verify the exact corporate name, company number, date of incorporation and registered office. Obtain certified copies of the certificate and the gazette publication notice for banking, tax and payment processor due diligence.
required_dossiers: Receipt evidencing payment of the incorporation fee
Certificate of Incorporation issued by the RoC
Official Gazette notice of incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Typographical or clerical errors in the Certificate of Incorporation are cured by written request to the RoC for rectification and reissuance; no judicial remedy is ordinarily required for ministerial errors.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Statutory Compliance and Tax, VAT and Social Insurance Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Tax Department (Commissioner of Taxation), VAT Office, Social Insurance Services, and the RoC Beneficial Ownership Register
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the registered office details, the director and secretary particulars, and the Ultimate Beneficial Owner declaration with the RoC within the statutory period. Register the company with the Cyprus Tax Department for corporation tax within 60 days of incorporation. Register as an employer with the Social Insurance Services before hiring staff. Apply for VAT registration once taxable turnover exceeds EUR 15,600 in any 12-month period or upon installation of EU B2C distance-selling obligations. Appoint the statutory external auditor.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Registered office consent and address verification
Passport copies of directors, secretary and beneficial owners
Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) declaration
Employer registration form for the Social Insurance Services
Corporate tax registration form for the Tax Department
VAT registration form (when threshold met)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late registration is cured by submission of corrective declarations and payment of any administrative penalties. Disputed tax assessments or registration penalties are appealable under the Tax Procedures Law and Article 146 of the Cyprus Constitution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account and Payment Rail Onboarding (Stripe and PayPal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Cypriot or EU credit institution; electronic money institutions regulated under the Cyprus Payment Services Laws; Central Bank of Cyprus AML/CTF supervision
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the full formation dossier to the chosen bank and to Stripe/PayPal under their respective corporate onboarding workflows. Present certified copies of the Certificate of Incorporation, M&A, directors' and beneficial owners' passports, proof of address, and a short business plan describing the ISIC 4791 online retail business. Undergo AML/KYC due diligence, including source of funds verification. Payment processors apply their internal underwriting before activation.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation
Certified copy of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
Passport and utility bill for each director and beneficial owner
UBO declaration or printout of the Cyprus Beneficial Ownership Register
Business plan and projected e-commerce website information
Stripe and PayPal corporate application forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank or processor issues a query, respond with the requested transactional clarifications and corrected documentation. A bank refusal may be escalated by internal complaint and thereafter to the Financial Ombudsman or the Central Bank of Cyprus where AML procedures are manifestly disproportionate.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Consumer Protection Service, Ministry of Energy, Commerce and Industry, Republic of Cyprus (for distance-selling compliance); Department of Electronic Communications and Postal Regulation (OCECPR), Ministry of Transport, Communications and Works (only where hydroponics equipment contains a radio transceiver module); EU Single Market free circulation competences otherwise apply.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sector-specific operating permit is required for online retail distribution of garden hydroponics equipment under Cypriot or EU law; general economic freedom applies under Articles 49 and 56 TFEU. If a device contains Wi-Fi, ZigBee or Bluetooth control, the product module must be notified to OCECPR under Radio Equipment Directive 2014/53/EU, and CE-marking under the New Legislative Framework (Regulation (EC) 765/2008) becomes a product-compliance obligation, not a company licence.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment, Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Environment, Republic of Cyprus
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from full EIA Report — warehouse and online retail logistics constitute a low-impact Annex II category far below screening thresholds of the Cyprus EIA Law 127(I)/2018; no Environmental Impact Assessment screening or public consultation is required for pure storage and dispatch of packaged equipment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source industrial discharges or VOC process emissions apply to dry e-commerce warehousing. Compliance obligations comprise packaging waste treatment per the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulations (EU Directive 94/62/EC), producer registration for WEEE under Cyprus WEEE Regulations 2013 (as amended), and battery end-of-life handling under the EU Batteries Regulation 2023/1542; default process VOC emissions are zero for pure logistics operations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Where a physical warehouse or office is used, obtain a Fire Safety Certificate from the Cyprus Fire Service under the Fire Defence Law, a structural load inspection certificate under the Streets and Buildings Regulations for the chosen premises, and a workplace health-and-safety registration with the Labour Inspection Department under the Factories (Health, Safety and Welfare) Law; employer registration at the Social Insurance Services is activated before any staff recruitment.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Taxation (Τμήμα Φορολογίας) of the Republic of Cyprus — Ministry of Finance; e-filing and VAT administration via the Tax Department e-Services portal (taxportal.mof.gov.cy); export customs procedures administered separately by the Cyprus Customs Department.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1 — Cyprus incorporation: a Cyprus Ltd receives its Tax Identification Number (TIN) automatically through the Registrar of Companies; no separate TIN application is required for a Cyprus-resident company. Step 2 — Foreign entity or branch: the non-resident seller files Form TD2001 (Foreign Company / Branch Registration) through the Tax Department e-Services portal or at the District Tax Office, attaching certified constitutional documents, certificate of good standing from the home registry, board resolution appointing a local tax representative, and notarized power of attorney; the Tax Department issues the 8-digit TIN upon complete filing. Step 3 — VAT registration: the entity must file VAT-101 (Cyprus-established) or the non-established taxable person registration form where it makes or intends to make taxable supplies in Cyprus; registration is effective from the first domestic taxable supply or establishment of a fixed establishment. Step 4 — Alternative for distance sales: non-resident e-commerce sellers may rely on the Union OSS (intra-EU distance sales) or IOSS (third-country imports up to EUR 150) instead of a Cypriot VAT ID, although a CY VAT number remains mandatory for goods warehoused or delivered from Cyprus.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — a Cyprus Ltd is a distinct taxable person; tax residence is based on management and control in Cyprus; resident companies are taxed on worldwide income at 12.5% CIT; non-resident companies with a Cyprus permanent establishment are taxed only on PE-attributable Cyprus-source income; no tax-transparent classification is available for a Ltd under Cyprus law.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election. Hybrid mismatch treatment follows EU ATAD implemented by the Income Tax Law amendments (Laws 117(I)/2020 and 58(I)/2022). Available elections: (i) Cyprus IP Box one-off election granting an 80% qualifying deduction; (ii) Notional Interest Deduction election on new equity; (iii) group loss relief election; (iv) VAT grouping election under the VAT Law; (v) advance tax ruling procedure to confirm classification and fiscal treatment of hybrid instruments and cross-border structures before filing.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Cyprus VAT Law 95(I)/2000, harmonised with Council Directive 2006/112/EC
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 15,600 annual taxable turnover for Cyprus-established taxable persons; no registration threshold for non-established taxable persons making taxable supplies in Cyprus; intra-EU distance sales of goods may be declared under the Union OSS once the EUR 10,000 EU-wide threshold is exceeded; IOSS applies to B2C imports of consignments not exceeding EUR 150.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing under Law 63(I)/2024 based on the European standard EN 16931: B2G invoices from 1 October 2024; B2B/B2C e-invoicing phased in for large businesses during the 2025 roll-out and for all Cyprus-established VAT traders no later than 1 May 2026 (as adjusted by Tax Department announcements). Invoices must be exchanged through certified PEPPOL access points using UBL or CII syntax and include the full invoice reference; Cyprus does not operate real-time tax authority clearance, digital fiscal stamping, or a continuous transaction control engine. The Tax Department performs post-baseline audit matching using VAT returns and e-invoice data, with a Cypriot SAF-T reporting framework under development.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under the Cyprus VAT Law implementing Article 146 of Directive 2006/112/EC, the 0% rate applies to: (1) goods exported by the supplier or for its account to a destination outside the EU, physically leaving Cyprus or the EU within three months of supply; (2) services connected with exported goods, including international transport, loading, handling and customs agency; and (3) services supplied where the place of supply is outside the EU, including B2C digital services. For the exporter of garden-hydroponics equipment, the zero rate is allowed only where the goods are physically delivered to a non-EU customer with transport evidence; dispatch to a Cyprus or EU address, even if invoiced to a foreign customer, is taxable at 19%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD / Electronic Export System exit confirmation with movement reference)
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill or CMR consignment note evidencing physical departure from Cyprus and arrival in the third country
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT MT103 payment confirmation from the foreign buyer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Cyprus Tax Department and Customs Department conduct post-clearance and desk audits that reconcile AES export declarations, VAT returns, transport documents and FX remittances. If the statutory export bundle is not produced, or the goods did not actually leave the EU, the zero rating is retrospectively clawed back and assessed at 19% VAT, plus statutory interest at 0.5% per month (6% per annum) and administrative penalties. Fraudulent or abusive zero-rating claims, including round-tripping, fake export documentation or artificial non-EU invoicing, are prosecuted as tax evasion with criminal fines up to double the tax evaded and imprisonment for the responsible officers; in fraud cases the assessment period is extended up to 10 years, and the local VAT representative and directors may be jointly and severally liable.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Form HE32) with accompanying financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of the Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Energy, Commerce and Industry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 42 calendar days after the anniversary of incorporation (return date).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of EUR 40 for the first offence plus EUR 20 for each month of delay; prolonged default may lead to administrative strike-off and personal liability for company officers.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of the Registrar of Companies – Beneficial Owners Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation; any qualifying shareholding change must be notified separately within 14 days.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to EUR 200 per day against the company and each officer; continuous non-compliance may result in registry annotation and administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent audit is mandatory unless the company meets at least two of the following three thresholds in the current and immediately preceding financial year: balance sheet total EUR 350,000 or less; net turnover EUR 700,000 or less; average employees 10 or fewer. Public-interest entities, listed entities, and entities exceeding these thresholds are always audited.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted by the European Union; small companies may optionally apply IFRS for SMEs. Statutory accounts must present a true and fair view.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The company secretary must annually file a confirmation with the Cyprus Registrar of Companies attesting that recorded beneficial ownership is complete and unchanged, regardless of whether any transfer occurred. Any change of direct or indirect shareholding exceeding 25% must be filed separately within 14 days.
